Request: Nyc grant (Dance) opportunities, as of 2026-11-01.

<listings>
{"id":"r1","title":"Obremski/Works 2027 VISION a

reply.critique: Every ranked listing can be applied for by a dancer living in NYC and states an award, a place and a deadline. They are ordered by award and fit: the $20,000 Manhattan performing-arts grant, the dance-specific Bronx fund, the dance-named medical emergency grant, the all-discipline Manhattan project grant and the $5,000 Queens artist grant. The Obremski/Works fellowships are dance-specific but only open to AAPI college artists or O-1 applicants, so leaving them out is reasonable. Nothing clearly better was left out.
